items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, we raised up together. Hamp, Milt Hinton, and myself. We was all raised up down on Rose Avenue.

ctx.x: Well, you got started a little bit ahead of them, didn't you, in playing?

I guess I did, because I don't remember what become of Milt. All I remember, when I started taking violin lessons, I remember Milt's people started giving him violin lessons. Then when he moved away, I don't know what happened.
But I got started playing with these different bands while I was still living on Rose Avenue. I played (inaudible).
